summary: Tutorial: fix the Continue button doing nothing. The UI check now clicks the coach button with real pointer events (waiting for it to appear after presentations) instead of emitting its signal, so this class of bug fails the check. Full check.sh and the table native checks were run on the previous commit; this change only adds a hit-test exemption.
